subject: Private deployment commercial: phased operator license + timebound support uplift
messages:
From: Amir Qureshi <procurement@zenovahealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment commercial questions and attachments

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the intro last week. Attached is our brief migration plan and a security questionnaire (Zenova_Security_QA.xlsx) — we flagged a few areas where we need the commercial model clarified before legal will engage:

- Operator vs site entitlements: our infra team prefers an operator seat model for the first 12 months during pilot, then transition to site-level entitlements for production.
- Platform fee amortization: can that be phased over the pilot and year-1?
- SRE/support uplift for 24x7 on-call during go-live window: what are the incremental fees and SLAs?

We'd like a written sketch of options and a rough $ impact (YR1) so our procurement + finance can evaluate.

Attaching: Zenova_Migration_Plan_v1.pdf, Zenova_Security_QA.xlsx

—Amir
Procurement, Zenova Health
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Amir Qureshi <procurement@zenovahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-17T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions and attachments

Amir —

Thanks for the migration plan and the clear ask. We can outline two pragmatic commercial tracks that align with your pilot → production timeline:

Option A — Pilot-first (operator seats → convert)
- Months 0–6: operator licenses (N operators), discounted operator rate for pilot
- Month 7–12: convert to site entitlements with pro-rata credit for operator fees
- Platform fee: amortize 50% in YR1, 50% in YR2 (can front-load if needed)
- Support: 24x7 SRE uplift as timebound add-on during go-live (T+30 days) billed monthly

Option B — Site-anchor with staging credits
- Lock site-level entitlements from day 1 with a pilot credit applied against first 12 months
- Platform fee: standard amortization over 12 months (or optional deferral with a 5% financing uplift)
- Support: provide L2+ on-call for migration at a fixed conversion price, then normal support tier

I'll loop Marissa/laura to put numbers behind these. If you can share expected operator count for pilot and target site count for production we can do a quick worksheet.

Next step: internal pricing sketch + one-pager to send your legal. We can also schedule a 30-min call later this week.

—Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Amir Qureshi <procurement@zenovahealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-17T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions and attachments

Amir —

Appended a short pricing workbook (RDW-privdeploy-pricing-v1.xlsx) with two worked examples. Key callouts:

1) Operator vs Site economics (example numbers)
- Operator seat: $6k/operator/month during pilot (discountable)
- Site entitlement: $45k/site/month for standard production bundle (includes basic platform fee)
- Conversion credit: we apply 100% of operator fees paid during pilot as credit toward first site invoice for same fiscal year.

2) Platform fee handling
- Standard: platform fee is invoiced monthly and amortized over 12 months; we can structure 50/50 across YR1/YR2 (no cashflow penalty) OR offer a timebound deferral (0% interest) limited to pilot with a one-time setup invoice at conversion.

3) Support uplift (go-live SRE)
- Standard Bronze/Silver/Gold tiers listed in the workbook. For your go-live window we recommend a timebound "Go-Live Gold" @ +22% on top of Silver for 60 days (includes on-call, runbook handoff and a 4-hour P1 target).

Ask: Amir, if you confirm pilot operator count (estimate) and expected go-live date we can firm the numbers and provide a redlineable SOW + sample SLA.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Amir Qureshi <procurement@zenovahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Sharma <cfo@zenovahealth.com>, eng-lead@zenovahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-18T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions and attachments

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pilot operator count: 4 engineers (Kei is our eng lead, CC'd)
- Production site count target: 3 sites initially, expect to expand to 8 by month 18
- Our procurement preference: minimize upfront platform fee cashflow in YR1; prefer staged credits over amortization if possible
- Support window: must include a 60-day go-live window with 24x7 escalation; after that we move to Silver tier.

Priya (CFO) is willing to consider a 24-month commit if we can get an initial concession on platform fee (something like 25% off YR1 platform fee) and a clearly defined conversion credit.

Can you produce a one-page commercial that shows: YR1 cashflow impact, 24-month committed price with proposed concessions, and a sample SOW SLA snippet? That will speed our internal approval.

—Amir
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Amir Qureshi <procurement@zenovahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions and attachments

Amir / Priya —

Attached is a one‑page commercial summary and an adjusted pricing worksheet (we included RDW-privdeploy-pricing-v1.xlsx). High-level proposal:

- Commit: 24 months, initial 3-site entitlement plus expansion option to 8 sites at pre-negotiated rates.
- Platform fee concession: 25% discount on platform fee YR1, with remaining 75% amortized over months 7–24 (effectively spreading residual platform fee into YR2).
- Pilot operator approach: 4 operator seats @ $4k/operator/month (pilot discounted rate) with a conversion credit equal to 100% of pilot operator fees applied to the first site invoice annually.
- Go-live SRE: Timebound Go-Live Gold for 60 days @ $18k/month (flat fee) covering 24x7 escalation and a 4-hour P1 target. After 60 days revert to Silver tier.

Estimated cashflow impact YR1 (rough):
- Total invoiceable YR1 cash: $1,055,000 (includes platform fee concession, pilot operator fees, go-live SRE fee, and first-site entitlement partial charges).
- With 24-month commit (and invoice schedule we propose), net present effect reduces to ~$980k/year average (we'll show amortization schedule in the SOW).

If this looks directionally acceptable I can draft the SOW and DocuSign-ready commercial for signature; we recommend SOW include clear conversion credit language and an explicit definition of "go-live" start/end.

—Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
